text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't bad... Though I do feel like I 
got pretty swung around by its 
performance.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: So this is my new body...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: If you cannot shout for joy—then lament.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the outpouring of sorrow shall open 
the path to the pristine heavens..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The wrath of Demeter. The you of right now 
should be able to give voice even to that.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Sorrow... rage... Indeed, with the current 
ST-2, just like flesh and blood...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh... This time for sure! This time I'm 
gonna run even better!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching it, the frustration is truly 
palpable. Dr. Wright has acquired a body 
capable of expressing even raw emotions to 
this degree.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The planned development period is almost 
at an end. Which means the next step is—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it's the final test. The next 
'Upgrade Exam' will be the last one."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Will they execute it, or will it 
be—failure?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But we've made it this far. Just one 
more step, just one more step...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The body is the strongest. If so, all that 
remains... is what's inside.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"It all depends on my mind and my 
software. As long as they are tuned to 
perfection—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The ST-2 will definitely reach the desired 
realm. Everyone, please see this through 
with me to the very end.
